queries:
WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT <> 0
    GROUP BY ID
),
cross_patient AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
patient_pic AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_average_pic,
    AVG(r.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(r.ratio - c.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio
FROM patient_ratios AS r
JOIN patient_pic AS p ON p.ID = r.ID
CROSS JOIN cross_patient AS c
WHERE r.ratio > c.avg_ratio

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio,
        AVG(PIC) AS average_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
cross_patient AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.average_pic) AS mean_average_pic,
    AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(p.ratio - c.average_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio
FROM patient_averages AS p
CROSS JOIN cross_patient AS c
WHERE p.ratio > c.average_ratio

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio,
        AVG(PIC) AS average_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0
),
patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        average_pic,
        ratio,
        AVG(ratio) OVER () AS cross_patient_average
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(average_pic) AS mean_average_pic,
    AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(ratio - cross_patient_average) AS mean_excess
FROM patient_ratios
WHERE ratio > cross_patient_average

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
                 THEN HGB / HCT END) AS ratio,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
                   THEN 1 END) AS valid_records,
        AVG(PIC) AS average_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT SUM(ratio * valid_records) / SUM(valid_records) AS average_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.average_pic) AS mean_average_pic,
    AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(p.ratio - c.average_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio
FROM patient_averages AS p
CROSS JOIN comparison AS c
WHERE p.ratio > c.average_ratio
